faq.title: FAQ: AI Hiring & Notice Period
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about LetsHyre's AI-Powered hiring platform.

items.q: How does LetsHyre's AI hiring platform work?
items.a: LetsHyre instantly parses resumes, conducts interactive AI interviews to assess communication and technical skills, and provides a verified scorecard so you only spend time on top candidates.

items.q: What makes LetsHyre different from other hiring platforms?
items.a: Unlike traditional job boards, LetsHyre automates the entire screening process. Our AI verifies skills in real-time before you even see the candidate, drastically reducing your time-to-hire.

items.q: How accurate is the AI interview evaluation?
items.a: Our AI models are trained on millions of data points to evaluate communication, technical proficiency, and cultural fit with over 98% accuracy, ensuring fair and unbiased scoring.

items.q: What does AI video Object Detection check for?
items.a: Our advanced anti-cheating system monitors eye tracking, detects multiple faces, and checks for unauthorized devices like phones or secondary monitors during the assessment.
Yes, we prioritize and verify notice-period candidates so you can build your team up to 40% faster with talent that is ready to join immediately.

items.q: What information does the AI scorecard include?
items.a: The scorecard provides a comprehensive breakdown of the candidate's Potential Score, Fit Score, technical strengths, areas for improvement, and a detailed behavioral analysis.

items.q: Can I integrate LetsHyre with our existing HR systems?
items.a: Absolutely! LetsHyre seamlessly integrates with popular ATS and HRIS platforms via our secure API, so your hiring workflow remains uninterrupted.
